title: Three toolbar directions for Excalidraw
summary: Compare a roomier toolbar, a compact command strip, and a bright red toolbar. All three keep the same drawing tools; Original is still the default.

variations.name: Room to Click
variations.idea: Larger laptop click targets, more space between tools, and clear focus and selection outlines.

variations.name: Technical Console
variations.idea: A compact dark toolbar with grouped controls and visible keyboard shortcuts.

variations.name: Signal Red
variations.idea: A bright red toolbar with an active-tool readout and an underline on the selected control.
